title: Machhi Singh v. State of Punjab

content.caseIdentity: Machhi Singh v. State of Punjab, (1983) 3 SCC 470
content.holding: Operationalized Bachan Singh into five specific categories: manner of commission of murder, motive, antisocial or socially abhorrent nature of the crime, magnitude of the crime, and personality of the victim.
content.relevance: Guides the preparation of the aggravating-mitigating balance sheet in sentencing hearings under Section 258(2) BNSS.
